name: Global Power Synergy Public Company Limited
summary: Global Power Synergy Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and distribution of electricity, steam, and water for industrial use to the government and industrial customers in Thailand. It operates through three segments: Independent Power Producer, Small Power Producer, and Others. The company generates electricity through solar, wind, hydropower, and thermal power plants. The company also engages in the maintenance, construction, and installation of electricity system services; and technical and consultancy services for power sector.
